stop_condition: stop if required source-mining artifacts are missing
stop if no near-boundary normal-success windows exist
stop if real wrong-history action/outcome gaps remain absent and branch needs synthesis
fallback_plan: if no near-boundary windows exist, design scenario/window coverage expansion
if near-boundary exists but no action gap, route to representation/action-boundary design or stronger cross-family source

self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Classify no-window, no-action-gap, action-gap-no-outcome, or source-diversity failure and route before any training.
